case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We highly value our twelve-year partnership and welcome your proposal for a 24-month commitment, which offers valuable planning security for both sides.

For the variant with 30 days payment terms starting 1 February 2027, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €51.50 per unit. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. To lay out the full terms clearly, our Angebot features a price of €51.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation between our traditional foundry and your esteemed company.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. In recognition of our twelve-year partnership, we are prepared to lower our price to EUR 51.10. Our current offer stands at a price of €51.10 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. 

This is a fair compromise that provides both sides with the desired planning security over the 24-month term. For over a decade, our family-run foundry has taken immense pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region. We value our shared history and look forward to continuing our reliable cooperation. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
